CFML Language Reference: Functions

StructInsert

Inserts a new key and value into a structure. By default it refuses to replace an existing key.

Category

Structure functions

Syntax

StructInsert(structure, key, value [, allowoverwrite ])

Parameters

structure
The structure to change.
key
The key name. It can contain characters that dot notation cannot, such as spaces.
value
The value to store.
allowoverwrite
If TRUE, an existing key is replaced. The default is FALSE: inserting an existing key throws an Expression exception.

Returns

TRUE (prints as YES).

Usage

Key names are not case-sensitive; StructKeyList reports them in uppercase. Simply assigning <CFSET s.key = value> also adds a key, and replaces it without complaint if it is already there.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Phone = StructNew()>
<CFSET Temp = StructInsert(Phone, "Help Desk", "x4357")>
<CFSET Temp = StructInsert(Phone, "Cafeteria", "x2233")>
<CFTRY>
  <CFSET Temp = StructInsert(Phone, "Help Desk", "x0000")>
<CFCATCH TYPE="Expression">
  <CFOUTPUT><P><I>#CFCATCH.Message#</I></P></CFOUTPUT>
</CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>
<CFSET Temp = StructInsert(Phone, "Cafeteria", "x2234", TRUE)>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<CFLOOP COLLECTION="#Phone#" ITEM="Who">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#Who#</TD><TD>#Phone[Who]#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>

See also

StructUpdate, StructAppend, StructFind, StructDelete
